about: Signs of each document type, used by BlurData 1.6.3 and later to suggest a preset for an opened document. The check runs on the Mac: the app downloads this file, the document never leaves the Mac. A sign is a phrase typical of the document, matched as whole words, ignoring case, accents and punctuation; weight 1 (common), 2 (typical), 3 (distinctive). See CONTRIBUTING.md.
